title: Travel Health Form
scenario: A travel-health form asks for vaccination records and card payment on an unknown domain.

answers.A: Upload your records and card details to the unknown domain.
answers.B: Upload only the vaccination page and wait for a confirmation email.
answers.C: Find the entry-health requirements on the destination government site.
answers.D: Use the official health or immigration portal you reach independently.

explanation: Health records and payment details are both sensitive. Confirm the official portal before uploading anything.
proTip: Check the domain and the government link from a trusted starting point.
